# Taco Bell Drink Menu USA

> Independent informational guide to Taco Bell drinks in the United States, updated for 2026. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Taco Bell Corp.

## Site

- Home: https://www.tacobelldrinkmenu.site/
- Title: Taco Bell Drink Menu 2026 | Prices, Calories & Freezes
- Description: Taco Bell drink menu 2026: Baja Blast, Freezes, fountain drinks and coffee, with calories and typical prices by size. Full US list before you order.

## What this site covers

- Fountain drinks: MTN DEW Baja Blast, Diet Pepsi, Pepsi, MTN DEW Zero, Baja Blast Zero Sugar, Dr Pepper, Starry
- Freezes: MTN DEW Baja Blast Freeze, Wild Strawberry Freeze, Blue Raspberry Freeze
- Refreshers: Strawberry Passionfruit Agua Refresca, Mango Peach Agua Refresca, Pineapple Lime Rockstar Energy Refresca
- Coffee: Premium Hot Coffee, Hot Cinnabon Delights Coffee, Regular Iced Coffee, Iced Cinnabon Delights Coffee
- Calories, typical prices, deals, locations and FAQ

## Typical US prices (checked November 2026)

- Fountain drinks: typically $1.79-$2.24, depending on size and location
- Freezes: typically $1.99-$2.59, depending on size and location
- Lemonade: typically $1.69-$2.19, depending on location

Taco Bell does not publish one national price. Prices, calories, availability and promotions vary by restaurant, size, season and delivery/app ordering. Always check your selected Taco Bell location for the current price before ordering.

## Key facts

- MTN DEW Baja Blast: 420 Cal (fountain, large size as listed on the site)
- Baja Blast Freeze: 190 Cal
- Wild Strawberry Freeze: 190 Cal
- Diet Pepsi: 0 Cal
- Baja Blast Zero Sugar: 15 Cal
